scope: Official OpenBindings browser surfaces, with named neutral-component and terminal adaptations

background.purpose: The outermost application or page canvas
background.rule: May also be used as the foreground on a filled primary action

surface.purpose: The default content and component plane
surface.rule: Do not add contrast from background when hierarchy does not need it

surfaceStrong.purpose: A visibly differentiated neutral plane for selected, raised, or grouped content
surfaceStrong.rule: May express hierarchy but must not be the only indicator of state

text.rule: Must meet enhanced text contrast against background and surface

textMuted.rule: Must meet normal text contrast; never use it to imply disabled behavior

textFaint.rule: Must still meet normal text contrast at the rendered size

border.purpose: Decorative separators and redundant grouping boundaries
border.rule: May be subtle only when the boundary is not needed to identify a control or state

borderStrong.purpose: Control, focus-adjacent, and state boundaries whose presence carries meaning
borderStrong.rule: Must meet 3:1 non-text contrast against the adjacent background

accent.purpose: The official filled-action and selected-state neutral
accent.rule: Use sparingly; official OpenBindings emphasis is the strongest neutral, not a decorative brand hue

accentContrast.purpose: Text and icons placed on accent
accentContrast.rule: Must meet normal text contrast against accent

focus.purpose: Color input for keyboard focus presentation
focus.rule: Focus geometry belongs to the foundations slice; forced-colors mode must use Highlight

success.purpose: Successful, ready, added, or safe outcome
success.rule: Never communicate the outcome through color alone

successSoft.rule: Success text must remain readable on this field

warning.purpose: Attention, waiting, running, or recoverable risk
warning.rule: Never communicate the condition through color alone

warningSoft.rule: Warning text must remain readable on this field

danger.purpose: Failure, destructive action, invalid content, or removed material
danger.rule: Never communicate the condition through color alone

dangerSoft.rule: Danger text must remain readable on this field

deferred: Public compatibility policy for generated adapters
